_comment: Printed scale bars photographed in FLMNH turntable captures, with detector codes
and photo-verified centre-to-centre lengths. THE DETECTOR CODES DO NOT DETERMINE
THE PRINTED LENGTH: codes 1675/1419 appear below on a 100 mm bar (labels 162/163)
and on a 0.05 m bar (labels 122/123). Before scaling a new capture, open one
photograph, read the printed labels and length, and record the family here.
Codes are the canonical CCT_20bit_black ids reported by PGT-Toolkit; labels are
the numbers printed next to each target on the physical Palaeo3D bar.
Pick the code pair with the most frames showing both targets; a capture can hold two bars, and a pair spanning two different bars looks plausible but is not rigid.

families.name: two_bar_100mm_subset
families.verified: photographs of the neurips subset scale position
families.notes: Two bars allow the full two-bar protocol: one primary, one check.

families.name: single_bar_50mm
families.verified: photographs across the full collection (majority family)
families.notes: Single bar: no in-capture check; verify the scale downstream.

families.name: single_bar_25mm
families.notes: Small bar; detection coverage is often the limiting factor.

families.name: two_bar_50mm_code_collision
families.notes: Shares codes 1675/1419 with the 100 mm family; treating them as 100 mm produces a silent factor-two scale error, caught only by the metric reference.

families.name: two_bar_25mm_11436_cranium
families.verified: photograph UF_Mammals_11436_cranium IMG_0479, decoded centres overlaid
families.notes: Two 0.025 m bars in one capture. The 140/141 bar decodes sparsely and its estimate disperses by 29%, so the 148/149 bar carries the scale.

families.name: two_bar_25mm_11436_mandible
families.verified: photograph UF_Mammals_11436_mandible IMG_0628, decoded centres overlaid
families.notes: Two 0.025 m bars; the 142/143 bar never triangulates, the 144/145 bar carries the scale.

families.name: single_bar_100mm_second_palaeo3d
families.verified: photograph UF_Herp_87980_lower_jaw Scale_IMG_7178, both bars print 0.1 m
families.notes: The check bar of the two-bar 100 mm set also serves as a primary bar where it is the only one decoded. The same photograph shows labels 122/123 printed 0.1 m, so that label pair is not inherently 0.05 m.
